name: John Floren
biography: is a Senior Member of Technical Staff at Sandia National Laboratories, where he works in High Performance Computing and security research. He occasionally puts odd operating systems on inappropriate systems, so far having helped port Plan 9 to the IBM Blue Gene series and Inferno to cell phones.
